name: VWAP snap-back
thesis: Morning moves stretched far from VWAP tend to revert toward it - frequent small wins.
rules: Session VWAP + volume-weighted std dev from 09:30. When a bar closes beyond VWAP +/- stretch_mult x std, fade at next bar open. Stop = spec.stop x ATR14 from fill; target = VWAP at the signal bar, or halfway to it. A side re-arms only after a close back inside the band. Entries 10:00-12:00, flat 12:30, max 2/day. Code: tools/backtest/nautilus/setups/vwap_snap.py.
